privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how Wanderlust.lv collects, uses and protects your personal data when you visit the website, use the contact form or make a booking request.

collected.title: What data we collect
items: Information you provide: name, email address, phone number, country, preferred language, tour or transfer details, and any special requests or notes.
Booking details: chosen service, date, time, number of people and related travel information.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, and cookies (see the Cookies section below).

items: To respond to your enquiry and confirm your booking.
To arrange and provide the requested tour, hike or transfer.
To communicate with you before and after the service.
To improve the website and understand how visitors use it.

legal_basis.title: Legal basis for processing

Your consent for optional cookies and marketing communications.
Legitimate interest in improving our services and keeping the website secure.

sharing.title: Who we share data with
sharing.text: We do not sell your personal data. We only share it with trusted service providers when necessary to fulfil your request (for example, payment processors, transport operators or email services), and only under confidentiality obligations.

retention.title: How long we keep your data
retention.text: We keep your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfil your booking, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes and enforce our agreements. Typically, booking records are retained for up to two years unless a longer period is required by law.

rights.title: Your rights
items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Request correction or deletion of your data.
Object to or restrict certain processing activities.
Withdraw your consent at any time.
Lodge a complaint with the Latvian Data State Inspectorate or another relevant supervisory authority.

cookies.title: Cookie policy

what.title: What cookies are
what.text: Cookies are small text files that your browser stores on your device so the site can remember your choices and collect statistics.

types.title: Cookies we use
types.necessary: Necessary — required for the site to function, language selection and security. Cannot be disabled.
types.analytics: Analytics — help us understand how visitors use the site (e.g. Google Analytics). Only set with your consent.
types.marketing: Marketing — measure ad effectiveness and personalise content. Only set with your consent.

retention.title: How long cookies are kept
retention.text: Session cookies are deleted when you close your browser. Persistent cookies are kept for up to 12 months unless you delete them earlier.

manage.title: How to manage cookies
manage.text: You can change your choice at any time by opening the cookie settings. Cookies can also be managed or deleted from your browser settings.

howitworks.title: How it works
howitworks.subtitle: Four steps from choosing a route to walking it. No prepayment, no agencies in between.
howitworks.s1_text: Look through the tours, hikes and transfers. If you are not sure, pick the closest one and write what you would like to see in the notes.
howitworks.s2_text: Give a date, the number of people and your contacts. Nothing is paid at this point.
howitworks.s3_text: Usually within 24 hours — with confirmation, the exact meeting point, time and the final price.
howitworks.s4_text: We meet at the agreed place. If needed, I pick you up in Riga, at the airport or in Jūrmala.

region.title: Where we go
region.subtitle: Four places that nearly every route is built around.
region.sigulda_text: The steepest part of the ancient Gauja valley, with sandstone cliffs, ravines and three castles within a few kilometres. The easiest starting point if you only have one day.
region.turaida_text: A red-brick castle tower above the valley, a museum reserve and the Song Hill next to it. A place where history and landscape line up in one view.
region.cesis_text: Medieval castle ruins with dark cellars, quiet cobbled lanes and an old town small enough to walk. A good choice for an unhurried day.
region.ligatne_text: A paper mill village with sandstone caves and forest trails in the middle of Gauja National Park. Of the four places, this one has the fewest visitors.

why.title: Why go with a guide
why.subtitle: You can walk the valley on your own. Three things that are harder to do alone.
why.i1_title: Stories that are not on the information boards
why.i1_text: What happened here, why the castle was built at this particular bend, who lived in the village a hundred years ago. The context that turns scenery into a place.
why.i2_title: Routes away from the main trails
why.i2_text: Ten years of walking here also covers the paths that are not on the car park map. I know where the view is better and where the coach groups are not.
why.i3_text: Timings, tickets, a lunch stop and the transfer from Riga or the airport. You only need to bring comfortable shoes.

seasons.title: The Gauja through the year
seasons.subtitle: The valley looks different in every season — summer is not the only one worth coming for.
seasons.spring_text: High water in the river and bare slopes. Cliffs that leaves hide in summer are visible, and the first flowers appear in the forest.
seasons.summer_text: A warm river, daylight until late and room to plan longer routes.
seasons.autumn_text: The colours of the valley in late September and October — the reason many people come here specifically.
seasons.winter_text: Quiet, snow on the trails and empty castle ruins. Shorter routes with hot tea halfway.
